parsed.rationale: Both `NowPlayingItem` (in `AppServices`, `Shared/AppServices/Sources/AppServices/NowPlayingService.swift:23`) and `PlaycutSelection` (in `app:iOS`, `WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/PlaylistView.swift:23`) are `type-alias-object` records sharing two fields — `playcut:Playcut` and an artwork field — differing only in the concrete image type (`Image?` vs `UIImage?`). This is a textbook PAT opportunity: the shared structure is real and domain-meaningful (both represent a playcut paired with optional artwork), and the single differing slot maps cleanly onto an `associatedtype ArtworkImage`. Introducing `PlaycutRepresentable` with `associatedtype ArtworkImage`, a `playcut: Playcut` requirement, and an `artwork: ArtworkImage?` requirement lets `AppServices` conform with `ArtworkImage == Image` (SwiftUI) and the iOS app layer conform with `ArtworkImage == UIImage`, eliminating the structural duplication without collapsing the platform boundary. Neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app` are all false), so no restraint override is needed.
